# teams_education_configuration (Data Source)

Look up an existing EducationConfiguration object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `edu_generative_ai_enhancements` (String) Maps to the -EduGenerativeAIEnhancements parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `parent_guardian_preferred_contact_method` (String) Maps to the -ParentGuardianPreferredContactMethod parameter.
- `update_parent_information` (String) Maps to the -UpdateParentInformation parameter.
